upstream.name: sddai/markerPDF
upstream.architecture: Python PDF-to-Markdown extraction pipeline using pdftext, pypdfium2, Surya OCR/layout models, table/equation/image extraction, and Markdown post-processing.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow upstream clone at .upstream-cache/markerpdf plus README benchmark table and .github/workflows/tests.yml.
benchmarkDenominator.ciAssertionSource: scripts/verify_benchmark_scores.py checks multicolcnn.pdf > 0.34 and switch_trans.pdf > 0.40 for marker output.
benchmarkDenominator.runnerBlocker: The upstream CI benchmark downloads benchmark_data from Google Drive and requires Poetry plus heavy Python dependencies including torch, surya-ocr, pdftext, pypdfium2, tabled-pdf, and model downloads. The shallow clone contains no benchmark PDFs or references, so the full runner cannot execute locally under the modest network/CPU constraint.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory. No upstream benchmark PDF/reference pair is mapped yet because the external benchmark_data archive was not fetched.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native PDF content stream text-line extraction for literal, array, hex, UTF-16 hex, FlateDecode streams, adjacent same-line text operators, PDF line continuations, and text line movement operators.
mappedUpstreamSemantics: PDF embedded text extraction feeding Marker-style Markdown conversion
Marker post-processing need for block-ready line boundaries before WordPress import

wordpressScenario: PDF import into clean post content and Data Liberation document conversion workflows, with fixture output convertible to heading/paragraph WordPress blocks.
nextTask: Acquire or sample one upstream benchmark PDF/reference pair and map it to a native PHP parity fixture before broadening layout/table/OCR behavior.
